dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (An aged sailing log, all torn and falling apart.)

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "Uncle Onitaka is going to send people to Sumeru... Every camp must help to raise money for the journey..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...There was a naval battle a few days ago in the eastern sea. It might be a good opportunity to scavenge some loot..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...I pray that Uncle Onitaka has a safe trip... Even though we, who have abandoned the Shogun, have no god to pray to any longer..."
